previousFindingDisposition.R1: Addressed: sections 3.3, 3.4, 5.2 and AC-CHANGE-004-4 distinguish source provenance from compiled identity and require a fresh build when relying on that correspondence.
previousFindingDisposition.R2: Addressed: section 4.2 requires sanitized Git execution and canonical repository-root matching; section 9.1 covers inherited overrides, unrelated enclosing repositories, linked worktrees and invalid metadata.
previousFindingDisposition.R3: Shared installation effects and rollback are documented. The newly specified lifecycle commands still need the selected C2C_HOME environment, as described in RR1.

findings.problem: C2C_HOME is assigned only to the install command. The subsequent installed c2ct stop/start commands do not pass the selected home. Executable location does not determine runtime state location.
findings.impact: For a nondefault intended home, absent or different inherited C2C_HOME can stop/start another test-profile broker and leave the intended connector on the old process.
findings.fix: Pass the same explicit C2C_HOME to every installed c2ct lifecycle command, including rollback restart. Alternatively scope one exported C2C_HOME over the complete procedure.

validation.actualGetStateDirReadOnlyProbe: passed: no C2C_HOME uses the default test-profile home; explicit C2C_HOME uses the intended test-profile home

scope: Only this review evidence file was added; plan and implementation unchanged.
